title: Dragon Hatchlings
prompt:
Clean black-and-white children’s coloring-book line art with bold ink outlines on white, no shading or gray. Elliott and Colette must match the attached reference children in facial structure and proportions only—do not copy the reference clothing. Dress them in simple fantasy-adventure outfits. Keep their faces natural and recognizable with smaller realistic eyes and no generic cartoon features. Winnie, a small Chihuahua–Pug mix with upright ears and a curled tail, watches nearby. Scene: the children kneel beside a large nest of dragon eggs as one reptilian baby dragon hatches from a cracked shell; it should have a small scaled snout, little horns, tiny wings, and clawed feet, and must not look furry, mammalian, or puppy-like.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
